content.intro: Learn django's application registry and internals through a compact visual, an inspectable Django example, and a practical verification task.
content.why_it_matters: Django's Application Registry and Internals matters because a Django project has to behave predictably across requests, database state, configuration, and deployments. Understanding this piece makes the surrounding application easier to test, maintain, and secure.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: This lesson examines django's application registry and internals as part of advanced django architecture. The objective is to understand the behavior, connect it to the listed subtopics, and verify it with a small example rather than relying on memorized syntax.

content_blocks.title: What to cover
content_blocks.text: The source syllabus for this lesson names: The app registry; Model loading; App readiness; Initialization order; Avoiding unsafe import-time side effects. Keep these distinct concepts together: know what each item does, when it applies, and what assumption must be verified in your project.
